mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM task_card WHERE DATE(created_at) = CURDATE() AND is_deleted = 0
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM task_card WHERE DATE(completed_at) = CURDATE() AND status = 'COMPLETED' AND is_deleted = 0
SELECT status AS `status`, COUNT(*) AS count FROM task_card WHERE is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY status
SELECT risk_level AS `riskLevel`, COUNT(*) AS count FROM task_card WHERE status = 'COMPLETED' AND is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY risk_level
SELECT AVG(score) FROM task_card WHERE status = 'COMPLETED' AND score IS NOT NULL AND is_deleted = 0

SELECT id, case_id, task_name, task_type, scene, status, progress, current_step, risk_level, risk_tags, submitted_by, assigned_to, priority, deadline, score, summary, hit_rules, created_at, updated_at, started_at, completed_at, is_deleted, delete_reason FROM task_card WHERE risk_level = 'HIGH' AND status != 'COMPLETED' AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY priority ASC, created_at DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT id, case_id, task_name, task_type, scene, status, progress, current_step, risk_level, risk_tags, submitted_by, assigned_to, priority, deadline, score, summary, hit_rules, created_at, updated_at, started_at, completed_at, is_deleted, delete_reason FROM task_card WHERE deadline IS NOT NULL AND deadline <= DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 3 DAY) AND deadline >= CURDATE() AND status NOT IN ('COMPLETED', 'FAILED', 'CANCELLED') AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY deadline ASC LIMIT 5
